items.title: Imdaad wins three-year Dubai Municipality waste and cleaning contract
items.summary: Dubai Municipality appointed Imdaad for waste collection, recycling and infrastructure cleaning in four Dubai districts, with 99 staff and 11,712 bins, for three years from March 2022.

contract.scope: Waste collection, recycling and infrastructure cleaning (99 staff, 11,712 bins)
contract.location: Al Mizhar 1 & 2, Muhaisnah 1 and Nad Al Hamar, Dubai

items.title: Imdaad wins Dubai Municipality cleaning contract for industrial areas
items.summary: Imdaad will sweep, collect litter, level open land and clean gullies across six Dubai industrial zones for three years, deploying 222 staff.

contract.scope: Mechanical and manual sweeping, litter collection and gully cleaning (222 staff)
contract.location: Six industrial zones incl. Al Quoz, Al Qusais, Jebel Ali, Ras Al Khor, Dubai

items.title: Imdaad signs AED 30m-a-year FM contract for Dubai mosques
items.summary: Dubai's Islamic Affairs and Charitable Activities Department hired Imdaad for integrated FM across more than 500 mosques and over 1,200 related homes, at AED 30m a year for three renewable years.

contract.client: Islamic Affairs and Charitable Activities Department (IACAD)
contract.scope: Integrated FM for 500+ mosques and 1,200+ related homes

items.title: Omniyat awards Transguard AED 14.5m FM contract
items.summary: Transguard took on MEP, maintenance, security, cleaning and soft services for Omniyat's commercial properties in Business Bay, including The Opus, for three years.

contract.scope: Integrated FM: MEP, maintenance, security, cleaning and soft services

items.title: Enova renews five-year Sharjah International Airport FM contract
items.summary: Sharjah Airport Authority renewed Enova's contract for technical FM of airport buildings and airfield systems, adding energy performance management.

contract.scope: Technical FM: MEP, flight displays, security systems, airfield lighting and runway maintenance, energy management

items.title: Berkeley's Burj Khalifa cleaning contract extended from 2026
items.summary: Emaar extended Berkeley Services' maintenance cleaning of the Burj Khalifa (lobby, offices, residences and visitor areas) from 1 January 2026; Berkeley has cleaned the tower since it opened in 2010.

contract.scope: Maintenance cleaning: lobby, offices, residences and visitor areas

items.title: Berkeley wins full FM contract for Cayan Tower
items.summary: Berkeley Services was awarded complete facility management of Dubai Marina's Cayan Tower, covering cleaning, security, landscaping, laundry, waste and pest control.

contract.scope: Complete FM: cleaning, security, landscaping, laundry, waste and pest control

items.title: Dulsco extends waste contract with The Sevens Stadium to 2027
items.summary: Dulsco Environment expanded its agreement to run year-round waste management at The Sevens Stadium, including the Emirates Dubai 7s, through 2027.

contract.scope: Year-round waste management incl. Emirates Dubai 7s; runs to 2027

items.title: Premier Inn appoints Dulsco for hotel waste management
items.summary: Premier Inn Middle East appointed Dulsco Environment as waste management provider for its Dubai hotels, with segregation, staff training and audits.

contract.scope: Waste management, segregation, staff training and audits

items.title: ServeU wins three-year FM contract for Ayedh Tower
items.summary: ServeU will provide all FM services, including cleaning, lifeguards and MEP, for the Ayedh Tower residential building in Al Jaddaf for three years.

contract.client: Ayedh Hussein Bin Dejem Real Estate Group
contract.scope: Full FM: cleaning, lifeguards and MEP for Ayedh Tower

items.title: ServeU wins AED 18m FM and staffing contracts for 14 Expo 2020 pavilions
items.summary: ServeU secured 14 contracts worth AED 18m to provide FM and staffing, including guides, cleaning, security and logistics, for Expo 2020 Dubai pavilions.

contract.scope: FM and staffing: guides, cleaning, security, admin and logistics

items.title: JLL appoints ENGIE Solutions for integrated FM at B1 Mall
items.summary: ENGIE Solutions took on fully integrated hard and soft FM, security and specialist systems, including chillers and water features, at B1 Mall in Al Barsha for JLL.

contract.scope: Integrated hard and soft FM, security, chiller plant and water features

items.title: Idama wins multi-year O&M contract for Deira Waterfront Properties
items.summary: Ithra Dubai appointed Idama for operations and maintenance of the first Deira Waterfront completions, covering handover, MEP and fabric, soft services, a 24-hour help desk and CAFM.

contract.scope: O&M: handover and DLP, MEP and fabric, soft services, help desk, CAFM

items.title: Dubai Developments picks Farnek for three-year FM of four properties
items.summary: Farnek took on MEP, HVAC, cleaning, pest control and landscaping for Blue Tower, Al Murooj residences, Village Mall and Al Hudaiba Award Complex, mobilising over 100 staff.

contract.scope: Integrated FM: MEP, HVAC, cleaning, pest control, landscaping (100+ staff)
contract.location: Blue Tower, Al Murooj, Village Mall, Al Hudaiba Award, Dubai

items.title: Khidmah wins three-year Ministry of Education FM contract
items.summary: The Ministry of Education awarded Khidmah maintenance and FM services for its assets for three years.

contract.scope: Maintenance and FM services for ministry assets

items.summary: EFS took on all facilities services (MEP, cleaning, support and specialist services) across Etihad Airways' UAE facilities under a five-year, AED 140m contract starting April 2018.
items.title: EFS wins five-year integrated FM contract for Etihad Airways
